## Summary

<!-- What does this change and why? Link any related issue. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] feat: new feature
- [ ] fix: bug fix
- [ ] docs: documentation only
- [ ] style: formatting or visual change, no behaviour change
- [ ] refactor: code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
- [ ] chore / ci: tooling, dependencies or pipeline

## Screenshots

<!-- For visual changes: before and after, light and dark mode, mobile and desktop. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] Legal text changed (`content/*.md`)?
  - [ ] If yes: `updated` date in the frontmatter is updated
  - [ ] If yes: the change has been through legal review
- [ ] New environment variables are added to `.env.example`, `src/env.ts` and the README
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or personal data in the diff
